note: Issue #321: the inside of a barracks hall, one template for every barracks (the square port, the round port and every generated town with a barracks). A town box with "interior": "barracks" is stamped with it when its town loads (src/systems/world/barracks_hall.gd, BarracksHall.stamp): the box stops being solid (kind "shell", drawn from outside by the building kit) and becomes walls, a roof and a doorway in its door face, a corridor along the length of the hall, an office behind the corridor straight in from the door (the Remnant cruiser's control room: rows of consoles, screens, a holo table with the planet map, OutpostRoom's layout) and a bunk room in front of the corridor beside the way in. The rest of the hall is rooms you can not open: solid, with locked doors (TownBuildings.door, closed, red light) on their faces. Metres. Local frame: depth runs from the back wall to the door face, length along the door face. wall: outer wall and roof thickness; partition: inner walls. door_scale / inner_door_scale: the sci-fi door's scale for the way in and for the rooms' doorways (the gap is the door frame's opening: 1.14 x scale wide, 1.6 x scale tall). vestibule: the way in from the door to the corridor (between two walls). corridor: its width. front_share: of the depth left after the corridor and the partitions, the share in front of the corridor (the bunk room); the office has the rest. office.length: along the hall (clamped to the hall), office.rows: OutpostRoom's console rows (2: a second bank across the room), one when the office is shallower than two_rows_from. bunks: two-high bunks in a row along each long wall (bunk: [wide, long], pitch along the row, height), a footlocker at each one's foot, lockers on the far end wall; count is the most bunks; length the most the room runs along the hall (the rest is a locked room). locked_doors: on the corridor's faces of the locked rooms, one per corridor_every metres (at least one on each face longer than corridor_min); corridor_ends: one on each end wall of the corridor; office / bunks: how many on the office's front wall and on the bunk room's near wall. rifle: the story rifle (pickups/port_town.json barracks_rifle) is hidden in the office's middle console, at the marker this far in front of it. troopers: Remnant troopers (a garrison soldier profile) walking a loop from one end of the corridor (end -1 or 1) into the office round the holo table and back. lights: the office's red and blue light (as an outpost's), a lamp every corridor_every metres down the corridor and two over the bunks (the look only). alarm_lights: red lamps inside and over the door outside, pulsing while the town alarm sounds, off on calm (the look only). holo: the planet map over the office's holo table (CruiserHolo: the cruiser's 'holo' block with these on top, the whole map at scale times the bridge's size; here_on 'town' labels the port as here), built when the camera is within show_within.
